name: Example: Park Slope Methodist
input_text: Park Slope United Methodist Church is an open and affirming community in Brooklyn. We celebrate communion every Sunday at 11am with traditional hymns and a robe-wearing choir. Our youth group meets Thursdays. We welcome all regardless of sexual orientation, race, or background.

name: Example: First Baptist Conservative
input_text: First Baptist Church holds firmly to the inerrancy of Scripture and the historic Baptist Faith and Message. We believe marriage is between one man and one woman. Sunday services in English at 9am and 11am. Active children's ministry, AWANA on Wednesdays, men's and women's Bible studies.

name: Example: Bilingual Catholic
input_text: St. Joseph Catholic Church serves the parish with Mass in English on Saturdays at 5pm and Sunday at 8am, and in Spanish on Sundays at 11am and 1pm. We have a vibrant CCD program for children, RCIA for adults entering the Church, and the Knights of Columbus chapter.
